messages.subject: Spacing Between Legend Entries - legend.position = "bottom"
parts:
What properties can I use to create adequate spacing between legend
entries when I place a legend at the bottom on my plot? My legend
entries are too close together --see attachment.

--
Lighton Phiri
http://lightonphiri.org

messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: Spacing Between Legend Entries - legend.position = "bottom"
parts:
You can adjust the text size of the legend. 
Alternatively, you could play with the DPI settings of the output (?quartz(), ?windows(), ?x11(), or ?ggsave() ). 

If you want to simply spread them out more... I'm not sure. Attached is a transition document that Dennis Murphy put together that has all of the editable features (at least superficially) and I don't see how.
